```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Global knitr options (tweak as you like)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

# Libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(scales)

# Absolute path to your results folder
 res_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-FIFA.org/Projects (FIFA)/Competition surveillance projects - current/2025-FAC-Qatar/03_Analysis/Results"


# Apply global defaults to all flextables created after this call
flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
  #theme_fun   = flextable::theme_zebra, # base table look
  font.family = "Open Sans Light",                # font family
  font.size   = 9,                       # font size
  padding     = 3                         # cell padding
)


# Number formatter: 2 dp when needed, no trailing .00 for integers
fmt <- scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01, drop0trailing = TRUE)

# Thin border (width in points)
thin_border <- officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.3)

# ---- Reusable helpers ----

# 1) Read a CSV and format all numeric columns using `fmt`
read_fmt_csv <- function(path) {
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ fmt(.x)))
}

# 2) Standard flextable styling:
#    - remove header row
#    - remove all borders
#    - add thin top & bottom rules only
#    - full-width table, autofit

library(flextable)
library(officer) # for fp_border

style_ft <- function(ft) {
  # Number of display columns in the flextable
  ncols <- flextable::ncol_keys(ft)

  ft %>%
    # Apply zebra theme to body rows first
    theme_zebra() %>%
    # Remove all borders everywhere (header, body, footer)
    border_remove() %>%
    # As some document templates still show outer borders, explicitly clear them
    border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "transparent", width = 0)) %>%
    border_inner_h(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "transparent", width = 0)) %>%
    border_inner_v(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "transparent", width = 0)) %>%

    # Header styling: white background, not bold, left-align first column, center the rest
    bg(part = "header", bg = "white") %>%
    bold(part = "header", bold = FALSE) %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left",   part = "header") %>%
    align(j = 2:ncols, align = "center", part = "header") %>%

    # Body alignment: left first column, center the rest
    align(j = 1, align = "left",   part = "body") %>%
    align(j = 2:ncols, align = "center", part = "body") %>%

    # Reintroduce only the horizontal top & bottom lines on the body
    hline_top(part = "header", border = thin_border) %>%
    hline_top(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%

    # Fit layout
    set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit")
}


```

**Pattern of all time-loss injuries by body area, pathology type and selected diagnoses**

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

# --- Data ---
df <- read_fmt_csv(file.path(res_dir, "table_injury_all_tl_1_3_4.csv")) %>%
  filter(level != 2) 

# Indent simulation in the first header cell (multi-line)
nbsp10 <- strrep("\u00A0", 5)  # small indent
nbsp20 <- strrep("\u00A0", 10)  # larger indent

# Define header chunk props: Open Sans Light size 9
hdr_normal <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9)
hdr_bold   <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9, bold = TRUE)
hdr_italic <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9, italic = TRUE)

ft <- flextable(df) %>%
  style_ft() %>%
  # Body alignment
  align(j = 2,           align = "left",  part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c(4, 6, 8),  align = "right", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c(5, 7, 9),  align = "left",  part = "all") %>%
  # Body row formatting based on 'level'
  bold(   i = ~ level == 1, j = "label", bold = TRUE) %>%
  padding(i = ~ level == 3, j = 2, padding.left = 10) %>%
  padding(i = ~ level == 4, j = 2, padding.left = 20) %>%
  italic( i = ~ level == 4, j = 2, italic = TRUE) %>%
   # Body row formatting based on 'level'
  bg(i = ~ level == 1, j = 1:9, bg = "grey95", part = "body") %>% 
  bg(i = ~ level != 1, j = 1:9, bg = "white", part = "body") %>% 

  # Top border for body
  hline_top(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%
  # Drop first column (level)
  delete_columns(j = 1) %>%
  # Merge header spans (single header row)
  merge_at(j = 3:4, part = "header") %>%
  merge_at(j = 5:6, part = "header") %>%
  merge_at(j = 7:8, part = "header") %>%
  # Header labels (apply chunk props to ensure font)
  compose(
    part = "header", j = 2,
    value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Cases\n(n)", props = hdr_normal))
  ) %>%
  compose(
    part = "header", j = 3,
    value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Incidence\n[95% CI]", props = hdr_normal))
  ) %>%
  compose(
    part = "header", j = 5,
    value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Median time loss\n(IQR)", props = hdr_normal))
  ) %>%
  compose(
    part = "header", j = 7,
    value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Burden\n[95% CI]", props = hdr_normal))
  ) %>%
  # First header cell: three lines with per-chunk font props
  compose(
    part  = "header", j = 1,
    value = as_paragraph(
      as_chunk("Body part",                 props = hdr_bold),   "\n",
      as_chunk(paste0(nbsp10, "Pathology type"), props = hdr_normal), "\n",
      as_chunk(paste0(nbsp20, "Diagnosis"),      props = hdr_italic)
    )
  ) %>%
  # Header alignment (first cell left, others centered)
  align(j = 1,   align = "left",   part = "header") %>%
  align(j = 2:8, align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  valign(valign = "bottom", part = "header") %>%
  # Body font (Open Sans Light size 9)
  font(part = "body",   fontname = "Open Sans Light") %>%
  fontsize(part = "body", size = 9) %>%
  # Fit columns
  autofit()

ft <- ft %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    values = "For confidentiality reasons, specific diagnoses are only presented if five or more of the same diagnosis were recorded. Median time loss is only reported for categories with more than one case, Interquartile range (IQR) for time-loss days is only reported for subcategories containing five or more cases. Non-specific diagnoses are not included."
  ) %>%
  font(part = "footer", fontname = "Open Sans Light") %>%
  fontsize(part = "footer", size = 7) %>%
  align(j = 1:8, align = "left", part = "footer")

ft

```

\pagebreak

**Number of injuries by body area and time lost from normal football participation**

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(grDevices)

# --- Read the CSV with explicit types ---
df <- read_csv(file.path(res_dir, "time_loss_table.csv"),
               col_types = cols(
                 osiics_16_level_1 = col_character(),
                 `1-3 days`        = col_double(),
                 `4-7 days`        = col_double(),
                 `8-28 days`       = col_double(),
                 `29-90 days`      = col_double(),
                 `91-180 days`     = col_double(),
                 Total             = col_double()
               ),
               na = c("NA", "", " ")
)

# Columns to heatmap (all numeric bins + Total)
num_cols <- names(df)[-1]

# --- Global palette and range ---
pal     <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#084594"))  # Blues
levels  <- pal(100)
rng     <- range(unlist(df[num_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
  rng <- c(0, ifelse(is.finite(rng[2]) && rng[2] != 0, rng[2], 1))
}

# Map numeric vector to heatmap colors (global scale)
col_colors <- function(v) {
  norm <- (v - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
  out  <- rep("#FFFFFF", length(v))
  ok   <- is.finite(norm)
  idx  <- pmax(1, pmin(100, floor(norm[ok] * 99) + 1))
  out[ok] <- levels[idx]
  list(bg = out, norm = replace(norm, !ok, NA_real_))
}

# Build color matrices
m_list   <- lapply(df[num_cols], col_colors)
bg_mat   <- do.call(cbind, lapply(m_list, `[[`, "bg"))
norm_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(m_list, `[[`, "norm"))
colnames(bg_mat) <- num_cols

# --- Build flextable (NO theme_zebra here) ---
ft <- flextable(df)

# Locally disable any zebra/striping by force-setting the label column bg to white
ft <- bg(ft, i = seq_len(nrow(df)), j = 1, bg = "#FFFFFF", part = "body")

# Apply heatmap backgrounds for numeric columns
for (j in seq_along(num_cols)) {
  ft <- bg(ft, i = seq_len(nrow(df)), j = num_cols[j], bg = bg_mat[, j])
}

# Improve contrast: white text on darker cells
cutoff <- 0.78
for (j in seq_along(num_cols)) {
  white_rows <- which(!is.na(norm_mat[, j]) & norm_mat[, j] >= cutoff)
  if (length(white_rows)) {
    ft <- color(ft, i = white_rows, j = num_cols[j], color = "#FFFFFF")
  }
}

# Optional emphasis: bold Total row label and Total column header
ft <- bold(ft, i = which(df[[1]] == "Total"), j = 1, bold = TRUE)
ft <- bold(ft, j = which(names(df) == "Total"), part = "header", bold = TRUE)

ft <- autofit(ft)

# ---- Styling additions ----



# Column keys used by flextable internally (robust targeting)
col_keys <- names(ft$body$dataset)
first_key <- col_keys[1]

# 1) Align: first column left, all others centered
ft <- ft %>%
  { align(., j = first_key,   align = "left",   part = "all") } %>%
  { align(., j = col_keys[-1], align = "center", part = "all") }

# 2) Thin border spec (0.4 pt)
thin <- fp_border(color = "#000000", width = 0.4)

# 3) Header: white background + lines above and below header
ft <- ft %>%
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#FFFFFF") %>%
  hline_top(part = "header",    border = thin) %>%   # NEW: line above header
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = thin)       # existing: line under header

# 4) Remove header text in first cell (first column key)
ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = setNames("", first_key))

# 5) Horizontal lines above & below the Total row (search in first column of body)
total_row_idx <- which(ft$body$dataset[[first_key]] == "Total")
if (length(total_row_idx) == 1) {
  ft <- border(
    ft,
    i = total_row_idx, j = col_keys,
    border.top = thin, 
    border.bottom = thin,
    part = "body"
  )
}

# 6) Vertical lines left & right of the Total column (continuous header + body)
total_col_idx <- which(col_keys == "Total")
if (length(total_col_idx) == 1) {
  # Body: left & right borders for all rows in Total column
  ft <- border(
    ft,
    i = seq_len(nrow(ft$body$dataset)),
    j = col_keys[total_col_idx],
    border.left = thin, border.right = thin,
    part = "body"
  )
  # Header: left & right borders for Total column header cell
  ft <- border(
    ft,
    i = 1,
    j = col_keys[total_col_idx],
    border.left = thin, border.right = thin,
    part = "header"
  )
}

# 7) (Optional) Re-fit column widths after styling
ft <-     set_table_properties(ft, width = 1, layout = "autofit")



ft


```
